* A {@link TimestampSeeker} implementation that looks for a given PCR timestamp at a given * position in a TS stream. * *

Given a PCR timestamp, and a position within a TS stream, this seeker will peek up to {@link * #timestampSearchBytes} from that stream position, look for all packets with PID equal to * PCR_PID, and then compare the PCR timestamps (if available) of these packets to the target * timestamp.
